big_pour.headline: Amazon aims for one trillion in revenue
big_pour.summary: Amazon CEO Andy Jassy says the company plans to become a one trillion dollar business. To reach this goal, the company must continue its heavy spending on cloud computing infrastructure.
big_pour.why: Amazon's massive investment signals how much money companies are betting on the future of AI.

explain.kid: Amazon wants to be a huge company that makes a trillion dollars. To do this, they are spending a lot of money to build big computer centers for AI.
explain.pm: Amazon is prioritizing long-term revenue growth by aggressively increasing capital expenditure on cloud infrastructure to maintain its lead in the AI market.
explain.engineer: Amazon is scaling its data center footprint and compute capacity to support AI workloads, treating high capital expenditure as a necessary cost for future market dominance.

big_pour.headline: DOJ cracks down on AI student loan fraud
big_pour.summary: The Department of Justice is investigating thousands of "ghost students" using AI to steal millions in student loans. The agency is currently ramping up efforts to stop this activity.
